Legend

Island: a product in the public registry. Its pennant carries the colour of its sea, which is the product's public category.
Scaffold: the product is incubating.
Storm cloud: the product is degraded.
Wreck: a retired product, buoyed blue and yellow, beside its successor when it has one.
Fl GFl G 4s live · Fl(2) G 6s beta · Fl Y 3s incubating · Q R degraded · Al Bu Y retired. Chart-light notation: every island's beacon flashes its lifecycle.

About this chart

Products, lifecycles and the dates they were verified, licences, layers, categories, tracks, primary domains and public repositories come from MADFAM's public product registry (madfam-product-projection/v1, registry v4, last updated 2026-09-23), as vendored in solarpunk-foundry. Descriptions are the registry's English taglines (copy of 2026-10-04). Where a product has none, the card uses its role from the solarpunk-foundry README, or no description. Island sizes, shapes, positions and landmarks are illustrative. A repository is linked only when it is public. The rendering figures describe this device only and are not sent anywhere. Boundary: the registry projection is public by design, and private fields are removed before it is published. Policy: docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md.
